alerts.subject: Amsterdam, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, New Jersey, Silicon Valley Object Storage Upgrades - 2026-08-17

entries.message:
Event Type: Object Storage Infrastructure Maintenance
Start Time: 2026-08-17 13:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-08-17 17:00:00 UTC

Our Cloud Storage team will be performing upgrades to our Amsterdam, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, New Jersey, Silicon Valley Object Storage infrastructure. During this maintenance window, creating, attaching, resizing, and deletion of Object Storage subscriptions may be temporarily unavailable.

Previously deployed Object Storage subscriptions in Amsterdam, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, New Jersey, Silicon Valley will remain online but some requests may experience interruptions as backend services are restarted.

Event Type: Network Upgrade

We are performing system changes in the Johannesburg location during the following scheduled maintenance window. 

Start Time: 2026-08-19 22:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-08-20 03:00:00 UTC

We schedule higher impact maintenance events during off-peak times to reduce impact to customer infrastructure. Our engineers make every effort to minimize system impact, however, network reachability to Johannesburg instances may be affected for some, or all, of the scheduled maintenance window as we perform this work. While it’s important to be aware of start and end times of the maintenance window, due to our redundant network architecture, our engineers expect that you may see little to no impact at all while the work is performed.
